ontology.title: FIBO (demo subset)
ontology.description: A small hand-curated FIBO subset for the Modelith IBoR demo. Not the real FIBO — just enough financial-industry terms to show ontology-anchored modelling and remote resolution.

terms.label: Party In Role
terms.description: A relationship that establishes the specific capacity in which a party acts in some context.

terms.label: Party
terms.description: A person or organization that is the subject of, or is otherwise involved in, some transaction, contract, or agreement.

terms.label: Financial Instrument
terms.description: A tradable monetary contract that gives rise to both a financial asset for one party and a financial liability or equity instrument for another.

terms.label: Contract
terms.description: An agreement between two or more parties creating obligations that are enforceable.

terms.label: Position
terms.description: A holding, being a quantity of a specific financial instrument held by or on behalf of a party.

terms.label: Portfolio
terms.description: A collection of financial assets such as instruments and cash held by or on behalf of an investor.

terms.label: Financial Transaction
terms.description: An economic event whereby ownership of a financial instrument or amount of money moves between parties.

terms.label: Monetary Price
terms.description: A price expressed as a monetary amount per unit of a financial instrument.

terms.label: Monetary Amount
terms.description: An amount of money in a specified currency.

terms.label: Market Index
terms.description: A benchmark statistic measuring the value of a section of a market, used as a performance reference.
